note: Alters core's D7 menu-link migrations (via hook_migration_plugins_alter + hook_migrate_prepare_row calling MigMagMenuLinkMigrate) so more menu links migrate; ships a trap migration. No config/UI/permissions/Drush/plugins. Its runtime effect needs the core migration plugin manager to enumerate/run migrations, which is BROKEN on this site by pathauto - so evals do NOT run migrations. They are grounded only in module-enable state and the module's declared dependency on migmag_process, which are inspectable. Baseline: this module DISABLED. Introspection/execution toggle its enabled state and confirm migmag_process is pulled in.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal module migmag_menu_link_migrate do during a Drupal 7 upgrade?
evals.expected_output: It modifies core's menu-link migrations (via hook_migration_plugins_alter and hook_migrate_prepare_row, using MigMagMenuLinkMigrate) so that as many source menu links as possible migrate - including links core would otherwise skip - and traps genuinely unmigratable links.

evals.prompt: Which two hooks does migmag_menu_link_migrate implement to fix core's menu-link migrations, and which helper class do they call?
Which Migrate Magician modules does migmag_menu_link_migrate depend on?
evals.expected_output: It depends on migmag and migmag_process (it relies on the improved lookup/stub behaviour from migmag_process).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, has migmag_menu_link_migrate been enabled, and is its dependency migmag_process enabled? Inspect the running site and report both.
evals.expected_output: migmag_menu_link_migrate is enabled and its dependency migmag_process is enabled too (check with 'drush pm:list --status=enabled' / moduleExists).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site migmag_menu_link_migrate has just been enabled. Inspecting the site, which Migrate Magician process module was pulled in as its dependency so its lookup/stub improvements are available?
evals.expected_output: migmag_process was enabled as a dependency of migmag_menu_link_migrate.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, enable Migrate Magician's menu-link migration fixes so that core's D7 menu-link migrations will migrate as many links as possible. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable migmag_menu_link_migrate (drush en migmag_menu_link_migrate -y). It and its dependency migmag_process are then enabled; its hooks patch the core menu-link migrations at run time.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site migmag_menu_link_migrate is currently enabled. Disable its menu-link migration fixes so the module is no longer installed. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Uninstall migmag_menu_link_migrate (drush pmu migmag_menu_link_migrate -y); afterwards the module is no longer enabled.
